newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower on sales ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower on sales ahead of weekend.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed lower on Friday as participants were prompted to square their positions ahead of the long weekend amid uncertainty about domestic politics and worries over the New York stock market before a U.S. policy-making meeting, brokers said.
The key 225-issue Nikkei average closed down 210.61 points or 0.99 percent at 21,112.24. Its key December futures shed 140 points to 21,180.
"People wanted to unload their positions as much as possible ahead of the three-day weekend," said Kenichi Sagami, general manager at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd.
